en.topic_title: Tai Po fire: 13 Wang Fuk Court owners refuse gov’t buyout as 99% agree to sell
en.topic_summary:
Thirteen homeowners at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have missed the government’s deadline to participate in an official buyout scheme, according to city housing authorities.



Wang Fuk Court after deadly fire, April 23, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Owners had until 5pm on Monday to sign and return a letter of acceptance agreeing to sell their flats to the government in return for a cash payment or a new flat in another government-subsidised estate.
